record.description: The actual post record (text, image, video, etc.)

embed.description: Embedded content from the post record. Untransformed embeds keep their record types; when the AppView rewrites blob references to URLs or resolves quoted posts, it serves the corresponding #view type.

indexedAt.description: When this post was indexed by the AppView

status.description: This post's per-community admission status. Present on an accepted post, and on an author's own view of their non-accepted posts; omitted from a public postView of a legacy/bridged row. Optional.

acceptanceUri.description: AT-URI of the community acceptance record that admitted this post. Present only while an acceptance stands. Optional.

moderation.description: Active instance moderation state. NSFW contentLabels drive sensitivity presentation alongside record self-labels; a post that is only NSFW keeps its verbatim record.

origin.description: Bridge-written home instance hostname (e.g. lemmy.world); display only. maxLength counts UTF-8 bytes.

originUsername.description: Bridge-written username on the home instance; display only. maxLength counts UTF-8 bytes.

originSoftware.description: Bridge-written home instance software; display only. maxLength counts UTF-8 bytes.

origin.description: Instance this community actually lives on (hostname only, e.g. lemmy.world). Validated by the AppView at index time.

notFoundPost.description: Post was not found (deleted, never indexed, or invalid URI)

removedPost.description: The community's own removal decision. Served as a tombstone carrying the removal code, distinct from notFoundPost (which is indistinguishable from 'never existed'); instance moderation is served as moderatedPost.

code.description: The community's removal decision code (e.g. rule-violation, spam, off-topic).

moderatedPost.description: Instance-scoped or inherited removal tombstone, distinct from removedPost (the community's own decision); carries no content.

moderation.description: Public moderation state establishing the instance-scoped or inherited removal

authorDid.description: DID of the post author when it can be projected without content

community.description: Community context for the removed post when available

viewer.description: Viewer-specific state; carries the moderation actions the viewer may take on the removed post

blockedPost.description: Post is hidden from this viewer because the viewer blocked its author. Community blocks mute aggregate feeds only and never produce this member (permalinks stay reachable); the community's own removal decision is served as removedPost, while instance moderation is served as moderatedPost.

blockedBy.description: What caused the block. The AppView emits only 'author' (the viewer blocked the post's author). 'community' is reserved and not emitted: a community block mutes aggregate feeds, not permalinks. 'moderator' is not emitted either; the community's own removal decision is served as removedPost, while instance moderation is served as moderatedPost.

blockedAuthor.description: Minimal author info for blocked posts

blockedCommunity.description: Minimal community info for blocked posts

tagCounts.description: Map of tag name to the number of community members who applied it (e.g., {"insightful": 12})

tags.description: Tags applied by the viewer to this post

moderation.description: Moderation actions the viewer may take on this post, using the modlog action tokens. Omitted when there are none.

moderatedPostViewerState.description: Viewer state on a moderatedPost tombstone. Carries only moderation actions; the tombstone has no content to vote on, save or tag.

moderation.description: Moderation actions the viewer may take on the removed post, using the modlog action tokens. Omitted when there are none.
